ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Extrac32 Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Download or Copy file with Extrac32

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*extrac32\\\.exe.*") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\extrac32\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "extrac32\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.cab.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/C.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/Y.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\\\\\\\.*")))
